notes.title: 2025-08-10 1.1.0 version update
notes.notes:
[QoL features]


Accessibility option - Fog wall behind Arena: A gray curtain covers the combat arena when you engage in combat. It's there to reduce the visual noise from the background.
Graphic option - Darkened Light Projectile: Some flashing projectiles can induce headache or eye pain for some people, so turning this option on would reduce the brightness of certain glowing projectiles, even if it can look kinda ugly or unnatural. 
HUD Necklace pieces: The necklace you equipped will be shown under Gretel's face HUD icon. 


[Balancing]


Added one more checkpoint on the Wraith difficulty version of 2-2.
The secret object in 11-1 that can open up the path to the secret boss is now less hidden than before.
Some boss patterns in 11-S are slightly adjusted. Slightly.

notes.title: 2024/10/31 Halloween content update + bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween, reapers! Here are some patch notes. 

 A boss stage 10-3 is added. Just to give a closure to stage 10 before the final release.
 Added the body part destruction mechanic to the boss in 7-2.
 Lower the number of spewing goo pools in the boss room in 7-2 below Reaper difficulty.
 Fixed a bug where Harvest of Focus didn't do a shit. ....Yes, you heard that right. Harvest of Focus hasn't been working for the whole development time. Instead, the focus gain was activated by Harvest of Life. It really shows my developer skill.
 From now on maintaining over S rank makes you charge up all the focus meters automatically (on every difficulty). Nesting Focus enhances that effect.
 Enhanced the Dread Vines HP threshold to match the critical health indicator. (30% of the normal health is where the indicator starts blinking)

notes.title: Magenta Horizon 1.0 version - "Neverending Harvest" is coming soon!

[previewyoutube=jhsEV6dMwkY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Stygian Update
notes.notes:
Magenta Horizon's 0.9 Version Update is finally here! It's time to plunge into the abyss to get the job done... 
And the story is getting closer to the grand finale.

[Added contents]

- Stage 10-1 and Stage 10-2
- 2 new enemies
- 1 new boss
- 1 new necklace piece (and now it is a whole!) 
- Horde Mode is in the extra tab, and the ranking board is included!

[Changes for the base game]

- Adjusted some hitbox sizes of Gretel's moveset in an advantageous way.
- The starting-animation of the aerial XY combo is significantly shortened.  
- Ranged supporters of the 3-3 boss on Reaper difficulty show up slightly later.
- Carpet bombing pattern of 8-1 boss is slightly nerfed and it will always chain into a vertical strike attack. 
- 8-1's big optional combat arena is fully constructed(you can get an apt achievement for clearing this), and an additional arena will show up on Reaper and higher difficulties. 
- Boss rush mode's segments are properly segregated by the act numbers. 
- Current Act 3 bosses are implemented in the boss rush mode.

notes.title: 2023-12-24 Version 0.7.16 patch + Letter of thanks
notes.notes:
[Players, You have my thanks.]

Before this year wraps up, I want to show my gratitude towards the audience.
This game isn't the most intuitive thing you will ever find in the market.
The tutorials are rough, the visuals and music are both noisy and the obstacles don’t wait for their turns and rush at you. It would have been an intimidating experience for most people. 
Yet you guys bought the idea and some of you really loved it.
As a solo developer who wants to develop a game that I would enjoy the most, it's an amazing experience to know that there are plenty of people who share a similar fun-sensor. 
This year marks a special year for me because of that. Thank you so much, and have a nice holiday. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42774589/b6b50abdf333903dddc21d0941adbfd4b2bca5dc.png

[Upcoming Act 3.]

Act 3 development is still going on. If the flow of development goes on as I planned, the first half of Act 3 will be released around the early part of next year. Here's a little combat arena as a showcase. Trust me on this one, this level won't hold back punches. 

[previewyoutube=4l-CKn5v2vA;full][/previewyoutube]


[Oh yeah, The patch note..]
  
This will be the last patch for this year. It only consists of nerfs and balancing. Not a good Christmas gift, I know... but it has to be done. 

- All the time limits and total style requirements for all the stages have been adjusted (to be tighter) on Reaper difficulty. 
- Melee-based attacks will give a reduced amount of style bonus as a baseline. (Except for the hook attack)
- The stinger-to-swirling-uppercut move (Grounded-Down-Heavy => Heavy combo) now has a slightly-delayed starting lag. 

I'll see you next year.
Thank you very much, Vielen Dank, 감사합니다.

notes.title: [0.7.15 Version Patch Note]
notes.notes:
The holiday season is coming.... so here is some major stuff being updated before more people come in to play. 
- On-landing charge attack is a default player moveset now. You can see the tooltip in 2-2.
- Fitting to the change, Descending Falcon has a different buff now. (Activates hyper armor and increases the damage of the non-fully-charged release)
- All the necklace descriptions are slightly edited to elaborate a tiny origin story(?) behind it.  
- Subtitle function and option are included. 
- Loading bars are implemented. 
- Nightmare has a spoken dialogue now. (Please welcome the new voice actor John Whinfield!)
- Stage 2-2 is lightened up a bit. 
- Updated the cutscene art for Act 2 except for the final cutscene.

notes.title: [0.7.14 Version Patch Note]
notes.notes:
Halloween is near, so I have some scary updates for you all.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42774589/cc28620fae682f9af5f44e50388ff629d4f1849b.png


 Since "that CEO" is gone, I removed the splash screen joke as I promised.
 The game used to have a strict set of normal damage and heavy damage from the enemy's side. From now on, each enemy's attack will have a set amount of damage multipliers. This was added for future balancing and conceptual consistency. (for example, there should be a damage difference between getting smacked by a lobster and getting crashed by a train.)
 This also means, that some enemies will deal more damage and some enemies will deal less. But overall they will provide the same playstyle to beat them.
 Buffed the health of bosses in 2-3 and 3-3.
 Added more necklace inventory slots to provide more collectibles in the future. (There are no new necklace pieces yet!)
 Completely removed the boss's post-attack delays in Still Alive and Wandering Soul difficulty modes.
 Added the warning signal around the health bar which appears when the health is low.
